claim: Register the Captain-matched MVVA finished-site photograph to the 2025 City orthophoto and the existing city world frame with an 8-DOF ground homography, then project all seven Dodem body/head pixels: the original four on the first island (fit-only) and three additional animals on the adjacent three-animal island (source-aerial-validated). The 2025 ortho is used only for ground registration; it shows a construction ladder at the north neck, not animals. No aerial object is used to identify an animal. Positions are provisional and not auto-placed.

inputs.privatePixelsNote: Private photo/ortho pixels stay outside the repo; only source facts and control coordinate pairs are recorded.

method.homography: 8-DOF projective: orthoPixel = H * orientedPhotoPixel (least squares, normal equations)
method.chain: oriented photo pixel -> ortho image pixel -> EPSG:3857 Mercator -> WGS84 -> existing world (x, z)
method.cropTransform: original 4800x3600 -> oriented 1076x1000: oriented = Rot(+148deg) * (original - inputCenter) * scale + outputCenter
method.note: Eight point pairs supply 16 scalar constraints for the homography’s eight unknowns, so this is an overdetermined least-squares fit. In-sample residuals are not independent evidence; leave-one-out and the held-out round bench are the real tests.

cropTransform.note: Exact recorded crop/rotate/fit raster transform; half-pixel rounding bounded below .1m. +repage resets ImageMagick virtual page before pixel reads.

fit.caveat: Eight point pairs give 16 scalar constraints for 8 DOF, so the homography is an overdetermined least-squares fit and the low in-sample RMS is expected. The meaningful checks are LOO (max 1.80 m) and the held-out round bench (0.79 m).

islands.note: Visible pale-curbed woodchip island containing six inverted oak trunks; material confirmed by City2026 installed Dodem photograph. Boundary traced from aerial. This does not identify individual animal points. Northeast construction edge less certain; whole trace carries3m positional uncertainty.

Visible pale-curbed woodchip island containing turtle, musky and eagle, independently matched in MVVA finished-site overhead photograph. Island traces actual2025curb; sourcephoto identifies animals, not construction objects. Positionuncertainty3m, notsurvey.

animals.note: Body/foot location from the MVVA finished-site photo via the ground homography. Fit-only: no independent aerial validation. Height parallax and photo interpretation give at least 3 m uncertainty; not surveyed.

policy.heightParallaxNote: Animal body pixels can parallax by up to ~2.4 m of height; the 3 m / 4 m floors cover that and photo interpretation. Do not present these as surveyed.
policy.identificationNote: Identities come from the current MVVA finished-site photo only. The 2025 ortho north-neck construction ladder is not an animal and was not used for identification.
policy.validationNote: original4 are fit-only (no independent aerial validation). extra3 are source-aerial-validated: the Captain overlaid the projected centres on the 2025 aerial within about 1 m.
policy.registrationNote: Distinctive curbs give a valid built-site match between the finished photo and the 2025 ortho.
policy.headingNote: The eagle heading is a source head-only estimate with 15 deg uncertainty; other headings have no stated uncertainty.
